task.subject: Mail outbound DKIM signing domain guard
task.description:
Execute exactly one verified ChangeSet: cs-mail-outbound-dkim-signing-domain-guard-fd001-alignment.

Source/result chain: task80 completed/promoted outbound reputation auto-throttle at commit 5ffe43a0325e164f9d41b48e34aaef5eb0c1dd65. Continue IP-007 outbound SMTP risk-first domain work: every queued outbound message must carry tenant/domain-matched DKIM signing evidence before SMTP delivery (RFC 6376 + RFC 8463 Ed25519), with per-tenant key provenance and rotation/audit evidence. This is pure mail-domain policy/signing-admission logic, not live cryptographic signing adapter/OpenBao/SMTP work.

Owned scope only: crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/outbound_dkim_signing.rs; crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs module/error/export wiring; evidence/fd001/cs-mail-outbound-dkim-signing-domain-guard-fd001-alignment-*; evidence/multispectrum/cs-mail-outbound-dkim-signing-domain-guard-fd001-alignment.json.
